description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'ECB' currency controller within the OpenCart admin extension. It manages currency data retrieval and updates from the European Central Bank (ECB) and handles related settings and views.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class for managing ECB currency exchange rates, including fetching XML data from ECB, updating currency values, and integrating with OpenCart settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the ECB currency management page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading necessary controllers, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving updated currency exchange rates by fetching data from ECB, updating currency records, and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Retrieves and updates currency exchange rates based on ECB data or a default currency, involving fetching XML from ECB, parsing it, and applying updates to the system.
